author: PP15
text:
Hi Jiri,

for the first - you have amazing results!:)

for the second - I would like to ask you the reasons, why you entered EU short this morning like that. I was watching this pair at that time with some S/R lines and 15M supply, where the market was compressing in. What led you to take the first tarde as a BO (it seems to me your first short was a BO trade into compression - correct me pls if not) and let the order left in the market for longer time and not cancel it at the end of CP - point A, which is FTR or at the line below? Step in the market at point X and exit at A was in my mind. X - RT to SR line after rejection from 15M Supply.

The second trade you entered in M1 supply, it worked out very well and you aimed lower. From HTF I have no idea, why you entered this trade. For me, the price was coming from bear trap, maybe consuming "your" M1 supply, so another rise may occur, but no HTF help, so no exact direction in the market at that time for me. I would step in at RT (B) after engulfing bear trap aiming to C or the line below - the lowest point of the flag on the left (not on the chart), which was maybe the reason why you exited the second trade there.

Thank in advance PP15
